Use case: identity-preserve. New four-frame DASH sprite sheet on true transparent RGBA. Image1 is the locked physical character master. Image2 is an enlarged exact weapon/hand reference from that same master.
EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, FOUR square cells, full2048x2048 canvas preferred. One complete body per cell with generous transparent padding. Same camera, head size and body scale.
The user rejected prior sheets because the KATANA SCABBARD BECAME BENT. Treat the existing katana+guard+scabbard as ONE rigid physical prop whose exact outline is traced from image2. It has only the master's shallow natural Japanese-katana curvature. Do not invent extra curvature, bow, S-curve or bend near a hand. Do not stretch or shorten hilt/scabbard. Do not redraw it to match arm position: move arms to the locked weapon. Hilt axis and scabbard mouth remain tangent-aligned through one gold guard. The grip stays visibly held in front of the guard, the sheath mouth held behind it exactly like image1. Sword remains SHEATHED through all4 frames. Preserve the master weapon's angle relative to the waist in this DASH.
Action, from top-left to top-right then bottom-left to bottom-right: 1 upright ready with slight forward weight shift;2 rightward push-off stride, front foot preparing to advance and rear heel lifted;3 forward stride toward SCREEN RIGHT, one foot briefly off the ground and coat trailing left;4 lead foot lands with gentle knee flex, poised to return to upright ready. Modest lean only, no low crouch. Real natural leg/coat changes. Hands and weapon remain steady together at waist.
Copy master identity faithfully: adult handsome angular face with eyes and nose focused at screen-right along the movement direction, natural green hair, black coat silver trim/buttons/sleeve crest and green dragon lining, black trousers/boots. No looking at camera, no large head, no off-model face. Same refined 2D game art. No blood.
No aura, no dragon, no trails, no backdrop, no ground shadow, no grid lines, labels or UI. All empty areas genuine transparency. All boots, hair, coat and sword tips safely inside their own cells.
